## Summary / 变更说明

What changed and why? Link the related issue when available.

## Checks / 验证

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Public API changes include types, interactive examples and documentation.
- [ ] Visual changes were checked in light/dark themes and desktop/narrow layouts.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, disabled and reduced-motion behavior were considered.
- [ ] No credentials, private records, machine paths or generated build artifacts are included.

## Evidence / 证据

Add relevant screenshots and commands. Distinguish automated checks from manual or device acceptance.
